# ScholarWorks@UARK

> ScholarWorks@UARK is the University of Arkansas institutional repository providing open access to faculty publications, student research, theses, dissertations, patents, and peer-reviewed journals.

ScholarWorks@UARK serves as the central hub for University of Arkansas scholarly output, housing research across multiple colleges, departments, centers, and institutes. The repository promotes open access to academic works and maintains comprehensive records of institutional research, intellectual property, and student achievements.

## Core Collections

- [Faculty Publications](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/facpub_index): Repository of faculty research publications organized by academic discipline
- [Student Works](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/studentpub_index): Collection of student theses, dissertations, capstone projects, and honors work
- [Patents Granted](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/pat): Database of University of Arkansas patents and intellectual property since 1976
- [Browse Journals and Peer-Reviewed Series](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/peer_review_list.html): Directory of open-access peer-reviewed journals hosted by ScholarWorks@UARK
- [University Records](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/uarec): Collection of University of Arkansas institutional records and organizational archives

## Browse & Discover

- [Browse by Research Unit, Center, or Department](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/communities.html): Directory to browse research collections by University of Arkansas departments and research units
- [Colleges and Departments](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/college_depts): Directory of University of Arkansas colleges and departments with research collections
- [Centers and Institutes](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/centers_institutes): Directory of University of Arkansas research centers and institutes
- [Most Popular Papers](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/topdownloads.html): Listing of most frequently downloaded research papers from ScholarWorks@UARK
- [Most Recent Additions](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/recent_additions.html): Recently added research works, publications, and music recordings to repository
- [Activity by Year](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/activity.html): Repository statistics and growth metrics showing annual activity and submissions

## Getting Started & Support

- [Submit Your Research](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/submit_research.html): Submission guidelines and instructions for depositing research to ScholarWorks@UARK
- [About Institutional Repositories](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/about.html): Information about ScholarWorks@UARK institutional repository and open access policy
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/faq.html): FAQ addressing submission guidelines, publishing, and repository usage questions
- [Custom Email Notifications and RSS](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/announcements.html): Email alerts and RSS feed subscription options for repository content updates

## Account & Access

- [Please Log In](https://scholarworks.uark.edu/cgi/myaccount.cgi): User login and authentication page for ScholarWorks account access

## Home

- [ScholarWorks@UARK](https://scholarworks.uark.edu): Homepage for University of Arkansas institutional repository showcasing research, publications, and scholarly works
